blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian on Monday, Nov. 23, directed department secretaries to provide senators with documents and data to expedite deliberations on the proposed 2027 national budget. He made the statement in response to Senate Minority Leader Alan Peter Cayetano, who called for executive officials to cooperate with the chamber, saying “the power of the purse is with Congress.” “We beg the indulgence of the secretaries to furnish the senators with the data that they need to expedite the analysis. It’s really important to expedite our discussion on the budget,” Gatchalian said. Cayetano called on the Senate to […]...
